description: Department of Elections - Elected Mr. Ponnaia Ravchanthiran and Mr. Ramalingam Vijayaveeran as the Members of the Nuwara Eliya P/S
reasoning: This gazette content deals specifically with filling vacancies in a local government authority (Nuwara-Eliya Pradeshiya Sabha) under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the electoral process for local government positions, including the declaration of elected members to fill vacancies created when members cease to belong to their political party. This falls squarely under election-related matters, making it Type 7 (Elections Gazettes).
